note: A register's coverage per scope: every year a state of one of its variables spans, per register variant. Reference reads all four variables' 2010..2025 states; holdings reads only what the steward holds, the 2018 and 2019 tables. Twin of cli_scope/availability-reference and availability-holdings. Fails if holdings reads unheld states or periods, a year inside the span is reported as a gap, or the variants lose their years.
